title: For the TH market: Updates to mandatory certifications for certain product categories
breadcrumb: For the TH market: Updates to mandatory certifications for certain product categories
label: TIKTOK SHOP · CHANGELOG
subtitle: Updated 2024-07-15
html:
What is changing?

For the TH market, TikTok Shop is implementing new Mandatory Qualifications for certain product categories.

Category New requirement Mandatory Qualifications
Tools & Hardware > Hand Tools > Industrial Scales Important Document Showing Certification of Weights and Measures
Kitchenware > Kitchen Utensils & Gadgets > Kitchen Scales Image of product with 'Do not use the scale for trading' mark
For multiple categories of Household Appliances TIS Certificate Mark on Product Label

Starting from 2024-09-10, Products API will be updated to require the above Mandatory Certifications.

Which markets are affected?

The updates of the requirements apply to the local and cross-border sellers in the TH market

Who is affected?

Developers with applications that use Create Product, Edit Product, and Partial Edit Product

Which version is applicable?

The updates of the requirements apply to all versions of the related APIs

What action is required?

Without mandatory attributes and product certifications for products within specific categories, sellers will not be able to create and update products. Use the Get Category Rule to check what product certifications are required and pass the product certification files via the Create Product, Edit Product and Partial Edit Product to help sellers submit product certification.
